text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower is convinced her<n>misfortune brought
about the accident<n>at the Hanshin Racecourse and
the<n>resulting cancellation of the<n>Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yet despite the upset, her desire to<n>run in the race
and bring happiness to<n>her fans is unwavering.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She negotiates with the staff at the<n>Hanshin
Racecourse, the Kyoto<n>Racecourse, and even
Director<n>Akikawa, in hopes of finding a way<n>for the
race to go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Moved by her determination, all<n>parties cooperate
with each other.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As a result, the Takarazuka Kinen is<n>moved to the
Kyoto Racecourse.
